_meta.note: Strings for the suggest/correct flow and the review page.

suggest: Suggest a connection or correct this
title: Help improve the map for {name}
lead: Do you know a patient group, registry, study or researcher we are missing? Is something here wrong or out of date? Tell us. A person checks every suggestion before it appears, and it is always marked as suggested by the community.
pending: {n, plural, one {# community suggestion about this condition is being reviewed.} other {# community suggestions about this condition are being reviewed.}}

kind.legend: What would you like to do?
kind.outdated_contact: A contact is out of date

subjectKind.legend: What kind of connection is it?

field.subject: Name
field.subjectHint: The name as it appears on their own website.
field.statementHint: What is new, wrong or missing? A few sentences are enough.
field.evidenceUrlHint: A public web page that shows it, for example the group's own website.
field.quoteHint: Copy a sentence from the page that shows it. We check that it is there.
field.assistant: Did an AI assistant help you find this? (optional)
field.assistantHint: For example ChatGPT or Claude. We record it with the suggestion.
field.name: Your name
field.contactHint: Only the reviewer sees it. Leave it empty to stay anonymous.

error.unavailable: Suggestions can't be sent right now. Please try again later.
error.rate_limited: Too many suggestions from this connection. Please try again later.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

status.title: Your suggestion
status.thanks: Thank you! Your suggestion is in the review queue. It does not appear on the map until a reviewer has checked it.

state.auto_checked: Checked automatically, waiting for a reviewer
state.accepted: Accepted: shown on the map as suggested by the community

status.noChecks: The automatic checks have not finished yet. Reload this page in a minute.
status.privacy: Your e-mail address is never shown here.

review.title: Review suggestions
review.lead: Every suggestion stays separate from the curated map until a reviewer accepts it. Check the evidence, then accept or reject with a reason; the reason is shown publicly.
review.tokenHint: Kept only on this page, never stored.
review.unavailable: The review service can't be reached.
review.subject: Who
